reviews.comment: Overall, professor Morvant was excellent. I will say her lectures are pretty monotone. Although attendance isn't mandatory, there are individual/group quizzes every Thursday. I know my grade doesn't reflect the best on her, but go to office hours, do the work, show up, you'll be fine.

Dr. Morvant was a great professor! She had a great sense of humor and her lectures were always well-structured and easy to understand! She uses iClicker in class daily which is really helpful for learning the material. The class is extremely doable if you attend class and do the homework.

Professor Morvant is an amazing professor! I really enjoyed her sense of humor and the lectures were engaging despite the material. iClickers were only sometimes used for attendance and office hours really helped me (she's really friendly, just a little awkward). She's really good at explaining things, so don't be afraid to ask questions!

Attendance isn't mandatory, but it's highly encouraged because there are quizzes every Thursday. She has a very dry sense of humor, which I love, but others might not. She's a good lecturer and is helpful when asking questions! She's frequently available outside of class and is a fair grader. She's great!!

I want to say she's a great prof, but I didn't really learn a lot. Very monotone, but she's very sweet. Do NOT rely on the practice exams at all. Nothing like the exams. If you don't study, you will fail the exams. If you do study, you might still do bad. No either or. She's very accessible outside of class, and office hours are nice I guess.

Always checked for understanding. Would answer all questions. Always available if you needed extra help. Very caring. Make sure you study the notes and homework for all tests. Tests are very important. Pay attention, do the work, and study and you will be fine.

Professor Morvant is kind and truly wants her students to succeed! She explains concepts thoroughly and is willing to help if a topic is confusing. I appreciated that she responded to emails about homework help promptly. She understands that math is not everyone's favorite subject, so she explains concepts simply and with a sense of humor!

The class was overall very easy because I previously took calculus but she was not the best teacher. I had multiple occasions where I got a question right but she would take points off because she didn't understand my work. She's super monotone and unfunny. I would never take her again. Even if you're good at math she will give you a hard time.

Class wasnt too bad. Three exams and one cumulative final and you'll be fine as long as you study and do the exam review. Final was all mc so if you know how to use your calculator well you should be fine. Quizzes every friday rotating btw group and individual and def use notes to study those concepts. Super monotone lectures though, but not bad

Lectures are monotonous and mind numbingly boring, but concepts are explained very clearly and slowly. Half the material is learnt outside of class with mandatory videos. Quizzes every Friday, rotating between group and individual. Random pop quizzes to check for attendance. Three exams and a final cumulative one. You'll be ok if you pay attention.

Despite her often monotone lecture style, she really does a great job teaching the material. She is clear on what materiel will be quizzed and tested, and won't throw you for a loop. She helped me make an A in a really tough course load semester for me. If you put in the work, you can do very well in the class. Sit next to smart people and lock in.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class is pretty easy. It's never super hard, but the topics can be weird. Her office hours were also helpful. If you study for the tests, take the practices, and do your homework on time you'll be fine.

She is really sweet but the lectures aren't really engaging. She also does iclicker participation grades randomly so try to show up for class. Make sure to read carefully on tests. Ask her for help if you need she's really thorough. She's also generous with partial credit on open ended questions.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The professor goes over the notes in depth and well. With the nature of the class, the lectures kind of drag if you know the topic before hand, but she is lowkey funny and caring.

Class was very easy, I would take it again based on that aspect. She very thoroughly goes through the notes in class but you will have a lot of video quizzes to do outside of class too. However, it seemed like she was targeting me out for cheating based on where I was seated and by her hovering around me during tests. I guess don't look suspicious.

Ms. Morvant is a good teacher, her lectures are good (but a little fast, I'd definitely recommend printing out the lecture notes) and the homework isn't too bad. Morvant herself doesn't seem enthusiastic, but she puts in effort into teaching and is generous with partial credit on write out questions. The exams are tough, so study a week ahead.

She taught very clearly and cared about her students. There are weekly quizzes, and every other quiz is a group quiz. Her tests can be difficult, but she posts practice quizzes, which help a lot. She always gives feedback on quizzes and tests. Would definitely recommend taking her. She gives hints on what's on the quizzes and tests as well.
I went to office hours once and she was very nice. Lectures are boring but that's to be expected with math. Video quizzes suck but i didn't watch most of them and just did the quiz and was fine.
She's very thorough in her lectures and easy to understand, but can be very monotone. Excellent math professor. If you have to take 140, take her.

She was such a good professor. Explained all the material in detail and gave us hints as to what kind of questions would be on the exam to study. The hardest part about her class was the tests, but other than that it was manageable. Would recommend taking her if you have to take 140.

She teaches well and will really help if you go to office hours. Math is hard for me, but the textbook got me through it. Exams and weekly quizzes are standard. Make sure to do all video quizzes and WebAssigns, plus full attendance, because that will help your grade a lot. There are also occasional take-home quizzes, which obviously help.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: For an 8AM lecture, she made things bearable. Math-140 professors are pretty consistent overall, and she teaches the material thoroughly and efficiently. Quizzes and exams are standard difficulty, though they're all turned in in-person FYI.

When she walked in I thought she was student. She is so sweet. Her teaching is easy to understand and she rly wants to help. Go to her office hours before the test and you'll be fine. SHE DOES NOT ROUND. I got an 89.7 and she did not round it to an A. Please do your pre lecture quiz they actually impact your grade a lot (my demise). iClickers!
Very easy class. Funny professor and easy grading system. Pop quizzes on mondays, test weren't difficult especially if you understand the material. Would definitely take class again

Prof. Morvant is amazing. She explains each of topic thoroughly. She takes time before class to say the upcoming due dates/make us aware of outside resources that may help us on an upcoming exam. The exams are not like the homework assignments. Use the problems at the back of the textbook if you want to see questions like the exam. Moderate final.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Morvant is very good at teaching this class. If you go to class and pay attention to the lectures, you'll do well. Her exams are not bad, even the final was fairly easy. Make sure to do all the video lecture quizzes. Do a good amount of practice on your own because the class is very content heavy, and there's a lot you need to know.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Morvant is great at teaching the class, pretty easy to follow her lectures as long as you go to class and pay attention. Her tests aren't bad, even the final was pretty easy. Also, grades pretty easy. Only thing is she assigns video quizzes due before every class. Make sure to do all the 2 question video quizzes.

Prof. Morvant is very passionate and a master in math 140 as well as other levels of calculus. This semester was great. Good reviews and lectures, go to class. The exams weren't that bad, I was very prepared for this course. Hope I can take her again. She is extremely helpful in office hours and will def explain every problem you have if you needit

Get ready to teach yourself outside of class with weekly video quizzes, she goes through easy examples in class and then the homework is a whole other story. Spends entire class going through simple examples, and speeds through difficult topics last 10 minutes of class. Class is pretty homework heavy.

Dr. Morvant is awesome! She goes through examples and notes slowly and gives plenty of opportunities for questions. The content is not entirely up to her so some aspects of the class can be frustrating. "Practice quizzes" (test reviews) are given before all the exams and practice exams can be found online. Take Math140 with Dr. Morvant!

Prof Morvant is extremely nice and very receptive to any questions her students have. Her class was pretty easy, as long as you do all the homework and review the practice exams she provides you should do just fine.

Prof. Morvant is so nice! Class wasn't mandatory and notes can be accessed outside of class, but she'll do in-class quizzes on Wednesdays and clicker questions usually on Fridays. Tests and homework were super easy; lots of review and attempts, respectively. She genuinely cares about the success of her students!

She was amazing and sweet. Quizzes on Wednesdays so it was nice to know about them, had individual, group, and take home quizzes. Then gave quizzes before exams but really it was a "review" sheet that was very helpful. Everyday before class she put on the big screen all the information for that week, very nice to have that.
